notes.title: Version 1.0.2. is Available!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today we released Version 1.0.2. of The Windzen Hero that adds a few fun features, reworks some enemies and fixes some bugs that players encountered. Version 1.0.1. was uploaded a few days ago but we didn't feel it was a big enough patch to warrant a note. With two patches in the pipeline here are the changes introduced in both.

-=-=-=- THE WINDZEN HERO Version 1.0.2.-=-=-=-

GENERAL UPDATES -

 Improved the new health bar portrait introduced in V1.0.1
 Added an animation for the health bar portrait when Hero takes damage

HEAT LAND -

 Completely reworked the HellMet enemy
 Completely reworked the Blade Runner enemy
 The volume of the BGM has been lowered

QUICK LAND -

 The red light walls (also present in Direx Stage 2) no longer kill instantly, but deal a massive 25 damage
 The red light walls have had their animations adjusted to make it easier to tell when they will reactivate
 The Blade Runner enemy has been removed from Quick Land

FLASH LAND -

 Doubled the height of the death barrier under the stage to ensure Hero can't slip through it unharmed, leaving the game to hang as Hero falls forever

DIREX STAGE 2 -

 Removed a rogue collider that a crafty player can land on to save themselves from a fall towards the end





-=-=-=- THE WINDZEN HERO Version 1.0.1.-=-=-=-

GENERAL UPDATES -

 Ensured that platforms underneath checkpoints no longer despawn based on proximity to Hero and are always loaded in
 Removed Debug objects that were behaving as invisible checkpoints in some scenarios
 Changed the graphic for activated checkpoints to reflect Hero's current design rather than his old one
 Changed the graphic on the life bar to reflect Hero's current design rather than his old one

INTRO STAGE -

 Added Checkpoint
 Added platforms
 Added electrical hazards
 Added big and small health pickups to the stage
 The Sizzling Circuit enemy now has a death animation

AIR LAND -

 Added a platform outside the starting room to help prevent the foreground from obscuring the drop



-=-=-=- ENTERTAINMENT HERO Version 1.1-=-=-=-
The original Entertainment Hero remains at Version 1.1 across both updates


As always, thank you very much for playing The Windzen Hero!

notes.title: First Update!
notes.notes:
The Windzen Hero just came out yesterday but we already have a big patch worked out for it.
Here are the deets:

-=-=-=- THE WINDZEN HERO Version 0.9.1-=-=-=-

GENERAL UPDATES -
- Fixed a bug that caused the collider on the ElectroGron enemy to be far smaller than intended
- Fixed a bug preventing the ElectroGron enemy from despawning at the end of his path
- Raised the Health of the object that needs to be destroyed to access the teleporter to the 'Debug All-Stage Access' map from 50 to 500

METAL LAND - 
- Fixed Hero not playing his entrance animation at the start of the stage
- Fixed Hero not playing his victory animation at the end of the stage
- Slightly adjusted the placement of the 'stage complete' portal to make the final jump a bit easier to read

AIR LAND -
- Attached the scorch marks to the rocket launcher so they behave properly when the rocket launcher moves
- Lowered the Health of the Broken Battery from 700 to 350. That spot should be less of a bore
- Added a material to the shots fired by the Flame Cannons
- Renamed 'Flame Cannon' to 'BoomerOrb Cannon', seeing as they no longer shoot flames

CRASH LAND -
- Cleared some discarded visual clutter that could be seen during gameplay.
- Added some visual flair to platforms that looked odd without in-universe supports keeping them in place
- Added a short set of walls to prevent the second Crash Cannon from being killable while Hero is out of its firing range
- Enabled the image on the screen of Console 2

BUBBLE LAND -
- Added a self destruct timer to the Seeker Mine enemy so it can't chase you through the entire stage anymore
- Raised the roof collider of the first overhang room to prevent Hero from climbing over it and skipping the room 'World 1-2' style
- Re-added the underwater ambient noise from the original game

HEAT LAND -
- Added normal maps to the heat regulators that rise out of the lava in the background
- Added ambient noise to the gears that move the pathed platforms at the end of the stage


-=-=-=- ENTERTAINMENT HERO Version 1.1-=-=-=-
(Yes, even the original game got an update today!)

GENERAL UPDATES -
- Fixed Hero being drawn over the black screen fader after making a selection on the title screen menu
- Added a fade-in to make the exit from the main menu less abrupt
- Disabled Anti-Aliasing to improve performance on older machines

METAL LAND (EH) -
- Fixed the behavior of the Gearblade enemies at along last
- Fixed multiple layering issues with the gears in the background of the stage

QUICK LAND (EH) -
- Added new sprites to the platforms that were previously solid black. No idea what I was thinking back then.
- Fixed some layering issues with the colored spotlights

AIR LAND (EH) -
- Changed how the cloud platforms are structured to better reflect the shape of the colliders

WOOD LAND (EH) -
- Lowered the Health of each orb in the "boss battle" from 50 to 30

DIREX STAGE (EH) -
- Lowered the volume of the stage's first BGM by 25%

DIREXBOT BATTLE (EH) -
- Lowered the volume of the 'Mother Brain' laser attack by 25%
- Fixed an issue that could cause Hero to spawn at an invalid transform which causes the stage to endlessly loop
